newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star Ent remain firm after rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Star Ent remain firm after rights plan.

text.p: Shares of Star Entertainment (International Holding) Ltd continued to rise and hit a session peak of HK$1.93 before steadying at HK$1.91 in late trade, up HK$0.36 or 23.23 percent from the previous close.
Since the company proposed a HK$269 million eight-for-one rights issue on September 7, the shares have risen HK$1.01, or 187.04 percent, as of Monday's close.

"It was believed that market makers were boosting the price to convince investors to subscribe for the rights shares," said a sales manager at regional brokerage. "It was already at a very attractive high level in subscribing for the rights shares."
